entities.name: AI slop（AI 垃圾内容） (slop)
entities.how_described: 本集的核心敌人：AI 生成内容重复、缺乏契合度、低意图的质感；Thais 认为它比「出色」更容易定义，且被探针证明是可量化的真实现象。

evidence.quote: And our whole mission is basically, how do we end AI slop?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so we really believe that to solve this problem of slop, we have to decode subjective domains.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: How do we avoid these patterns of slop, which we'll talk about a lot today?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And slop is kind of the opposite of that, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I think it is hard to define what is great sometimes, but I think it's pretty easy to define what is slop in the sense that most people would agree.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I think it would be a bad case scenario for us to just be like, okay, the way to fix slop is for everyone to have taste, because I don't think that's necessarily realistic.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So yeah, I think this phenomenon of slop, by the way, is not new.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If you were in the internet as social media emerged, you probably saw a lot of slop before that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so this lack of fit and lack of understanding of context is actually a huge problem that leads to slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So you'll go on a little bit of a research journey with me here now, but we basically wanted to figure out, can we measure slop?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And for all these slop sites, we identified, we started identifying like what are the probes that basically mean this site is very likely to be AI slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And predicts slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This performed better, by the way, than most LLM-as-a-judge methods of asking an LLM to judge if that is great human quality versus AI-generated slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I think it kind of shows this pattern that we see in AI really being an actual quantitative thing that we can see in slop, which I find really cool.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So yeah, how do we fight slop, my enemy?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And by the way, I think there's a lot of conversation going around, how do you fight slop at the model layer?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: How can we create a system that almost becomes an inspiration machine for your agent so that it can produce something that's actually out of distribution instead of something that is in that same average and kind of mean that we're seeing happen with like the slop sites?

evidence.quote: Like how we can actually use this to even become a gate for slop and not let your agent ship slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: of almost like pre-created brand systems so that if they want something that feels dreamy, why not retrieve a dreamy brand system that already has been thought out to be cohesive instead of doing like a generative approach the moment of that might end up not so great or might end up again in those pillars of slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集反复讨论智能体在应用层容易坍缩到均值、产出 slop；解法是给智能体配灵感机器、品牌组件遵循和把探针当闸门不让它交付 slop。

evidence.quote: How can we create a system that almost becomes an inspiration machine for your agent so that it can produce something that's actually out of distribution instead of something that is in that same average and kind of mean that we're seeing happen with like the slop sites?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Like how we can actually use this to even become a gate for slop and not let your agent ship slop.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And essentially what it does is it can take, let's say, a brand URL and extract this into very specific components that are good for an agent to follow.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So basically, how do we turn something as fuzzy as a brand into something so structured that it becomes easy for your agent to follow that, but also for you to judge against it, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So yes, this goes and helps your agent to produce something better, but how can we also add a way for you to judge, okay, is the agent actually staying on track?

entities.name: 判断力 (judgment)
entities.how_described: 本集认为生产成本归零后，变得昂贵、比以往任何时候都重要的是判断力——辨别什么是对的、把问题拆解到能理解并构建解决方案的能力。

evidence.quote: So there's lots of things that actually need to be solved as context or judgment or verification at the app layer, which is why we kind of work across both.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so there's a few, I think I mentioned this before, but as the cost of production basically goes to zero, I think the thing that becomes expensive and matters more than ever is judgment.

evidence.quote: I don't even want to use the word taste here, is judgment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And so, yes, there's this side of judgment that is human judgment that I actually think is more valuable than ever, but there's also this side of how do we build the right tools and systems to fix pieces of this problem, right?

evidence.quote: And then same with intent and judgment.
